  | tips                     = Shining Crescents is unique in several ways ({{Forums|474375|April 2016 tests}}):
* It is the only '''two-handed light weapon''' in DDO, meaning it is the only finesse-able two-hander. Thus it's the only [[Weapon Finesse|finesse]] weapon that can gain +10 damage from [[Power Attack]].
* Separately, pure [[monk]]s are <u>not</u> [[proficient]] with this item but it still allows monks to treat it as a [[ki weapons|ki weapon]], remaining [[centered]] and with access to most of their class's special attacks when holding it.
* The weapon's type is Sickle, so it benefits from the  [[Feat]]s Improved Critical: Slashing Weapons and Weapon Focus: Slashing Weapons.
* Because it uses the quarterstaff attack animations, it benefits from the [[Rogue]] [[Thief-Acrobat enhancements#Tier Three|Thief Acrobatics]] enhancement for up to +15% attack speed and is a valid weapon for use with Quick Strike, Sweeping Strikes, Staff Lunge, and Vault. 
** But because it is not ''typed'' as a quarterstaff, Thief-Acrobat Staff Control, Stick Fighting, Acrobat Staff Training, and Staff Specialization do not apply to it.
* Despite its being a light weapon:
** it is not compatible with [[Swashbuckling]] or a [[Shadar-kai]]'s chain attack. 
** it cannot be used with an off-hand weapon (it's two-handed).
* Despite being a two-handed weapon, it can benefit from [[Single Weapon Fighting]] feats.
{{Bug|'''Shining Crescents''' currently benefits from [[Single Weapon Fighting]] feats, even though it is a two-handed weapon. This will be fixed in a future update.{{Ref|1={{Forums|478575}}}}}}

If making a cosmetic version of this item with a {{Item|Mirror of Glamering}}, note that it will only function correctly when a ''quarterstaff'' is equipped, as it uses the Quarterstaff animation set despite being a Sickle. {{Item|Glamered Weapon Aura}}s will not work on the cosmetic.

2026 tests
* You can [[Strikethrough]] with this weapon and hit multiple targets.
* Thief Acrobat: Quarterstaff attack speed bonus seems to apply and special quarterstaff attacks work.
* SWF + Offline Versatility:
** Icons are displayed.
** Melee Power bonus works.
** Attack speed bonus probably does not work (fully?); needs more tests. <small>(Slower than a plain sickle.)</small>
** Extra damage from ability score does not seem to work. <small>(Observed damage range 13-23 at 23 dex [+6 bonus], which corresponds to 2-12+5+6.)</small>
* Swashbuckling does NOT work.
* Shadar-Kai Chain attacks do NOT work.
